I want to plot this data as grouped barplot using ggplot2. I performed these steps:

test[is.na(test)] <- 0
q<-ggplot(test, aes(x=coord, y=value, fill=factor(exp))) + geom_bar(aes(fill=exp),stat="identity",position = "dodge", colour="black")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))+scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")

The bars which come in individual groups are not well-defined, can I border each of the bars in the group?

I will prefer ggplot2 as I have to add another layer of data wherein i have to highlight few x-axis labels which will be by referring another data set and merging to the existing 'test' d.f.


The coordinate 22036057-22046057, which is 7th label on x-axis, should have 2 bars. These are falling in the same 'exp' category. Even after colour="black", I get only one bar. I want these two bars show up with border around them.
